seoTitle: Resume Bullet Point Checker: Verbs, Metrics, Length
metaDescription: Paste CV bullets for a score per line: weak openers like "responsible for", missing numbers, passive voice, length, with stronger verbs and a rewrite template.
intro: Check resume bullets for weak verbs, missing results and wordiness.
why:
Recruiters skim. Bullets that open with a strong action verb, show scope and a measurable result stand out; "responsible for" and "helped with" do not. This checker scores each bullet on the opener, the presence of a number, first-person and passive wording, length and vague words, suggests stronger verbs for weak openers and gives a rewrite template.

It is a rule-based style checker, not an AI writer and not a judgement of your experience. Only claim numbers you can defend in an interview.
howTo: Paste your bullets, one per line.
Read the score and notes for each.
Rewrite the low scores using the template and the verb list.

faq.a: No. It flags weaknesses and gives a template; you supply the facts.
